scope: Only four pure Telegram source/test files changed. No consumer integration, IO adapter, database, service, task, main or sibling mutation.
changes: Equal-update-ID groups are compared before any representative is inserted or offset advances. Rejection fingerprints and accepted identity are validated; unidentified, mixed-bot, corrupt existing queues and oversized batches refuse.

Required Telegram security fields and numeric bounds are explicit. Negative group chat IDs remain valid. Malformed/unidentifiable updates cannot become fabricated update0 tombstones. Trusted local bot configuration is propagated without claiming transport authentication.

Bot-scoped request IDs and validated records/chunks; bounded workers/epochs, queue1000, batch1000, payload4096bytes, result16chunks. Empty payloads, invalid digest/state/attempt fields and forged accepted text hashes refuse.

record_result produces InboxResultReady and full OutboxChunk set with real SHA256 of schema/request/bot/chat/ordered payload JSON. No free-form completion digest. Send/reconcile/complete validate complete identity, unique index coverage, consistent totals and immutable digest.

Recovery is one bounded request at a time and aggregates every chunk. Pending durable output is result-ready; all delivered yields completed with original digest; uncertain/failed/inconsistent/missing output holds. Interrupted processing never becomes pending. Impossible send order is refused.
Optional read arguments parse as an actual empty JSON object with legal JSON whitespace. Nonempty/nonobject/malformed arguments refuse; unsupported mutations truthfully deny.

api_notes.removed: Old create_outbox_chunk, handle_restart and free-form complete_inbox_task signatures replaced; no existing consumers integrated.
api_notes.ingress: RejectedUpdate now carries update_id,bot_id,envelope_hash,reason; UnidentifiedRejection has no commit identity.
api_notes.digest_schema: uos.telegram-result.v1 canonical json.object ordered fields schema,request_id,bot_id,chat_id,payloads
api_notes.adapter_obligations: Persist record and entire result set atomically with durable IO; enforce actual canonical task/coordinator/clock and process fences; correlate transport response with same request/chunk; group only matching bounded request rows; stop-preserve uncertain effects. Pure values do not provide authentication, IAM, durable CAS or replay protection against an uncooperative writer.
